svg.title: How a release of the blueprint rolls out
svg.desc: Once the Release workflow has published and verified a release, the Rollout workflow takes the repositories of the release app one after the other, the quickest checks first. It starts the blueprint bot of a repository and waits up to 15 minutes for the bot and the checks of its update pull request, then goes on with the next one. A repository whose bot it can't start, or whose bot fails, fails the run by its name, and the others still get the release.
